WITH o AS (SELECT * FROM fact_web_order WHERE order_ts_utc >= '2025-11-27' AND order_ts_utc < '2025-11-30'),
l AS (SELECT receipt_id, min(sale_ts_utc) ts, min(sale_date) sd, count(*) nl, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dl FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code='WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-26' AND '2025-12-01' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) od, CAST(l.ts AS DATE) lutc, l.sd, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nolines, sum(CASE WHEN l.nl<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lc_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN l.nl<>l.dl THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dupl
FROM o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (SELECT receipt_id, min(sale_ts_utc) ts, count(*) nl, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dl, max(channel_id) ch FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_id IN (2,3) AND sale_date BETWEEN '2025-11-26' AND '2025-12-01' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT CAST(l.ts AS DATE) lutc, count(*) receipts, sum(CASE WHEN o.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order, sum(CASE WHEN o.line_count<>l.nl THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) lc_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE)<>CAST(l.ts AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) day_diff, sum(CASE WHEN l.nl<>l.dl THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dup, sum(CASE WHEN o.status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) canc
FROM l LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=l.receipt_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN order_total_gross<=0 OR order_total_gross IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN line_count<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nolines, sum(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' AND line_count>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) canc_with_lc, sum(CASE WHEN status='processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) proc, count(DISTINCT web_order_id) d
